name: Shark Park
review:
Shark Park is a cluster-pays beach slot on a hexagonal grid. Multiplier wilds move and merge into bigger multipliers, and in the bonus they become persistent.

Thunderkick rates it High volatility, with a 10,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.14%.

Inflatables, sunscreen and circling fins give this beach-day version of the hexagonal cluster engine a summery feel.
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
